# Backend Coders

> Backend Coders is a technology and software development company providing full-stack engineering, robust backend architectures, custom web applications, API development, and cloud infrastructure.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://backendcodersindia.com/): Official homepage and overview of Backend Coders services and solutions.
- [About Us](https://backendcodersindia.com/about): Company overview, mission, core values, and engineering leadership.
- [Services](https://backendcodersindia.com/service): Specialized backend development, REST and GraphQL APIs, web applications, and database architecture.
- [Projects](https://backendcodersindia.com/project): Portfolio of client implementations, case studies, and enterprise solutions.
- [Packages](https://backendcodersindia.com/packages): Transparent service packages, pricing options, and development engagements.
- [Development Process](https://backendcodersindia.com/process): Agile delivery methodology, architecture design, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines.
- [Team](https://backendcodersindia.com/team): Engineering leads, developers, and tech consultants at Backend Coders.
- [Careers](https://backendcodersindia.com/career): Open tech roles, job requirements, and opportunities to join our development team.
- [Contact](https://backendcodersindia.com/contact): Inquiries, technical consultation requests, and office contact information.
- [Blog](https://backendcodersindia.com/blog): Technical insights, software architecture guides, and web development updates.
